title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Job-Site Delivery Terms
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental delivers equipment to the job site and picks it up again in the classes that offer delivery, at the class rates of the delivery table.

**1. Availability.** Job-site delivery is offered only where the class offers delivery and the one-way distance from the store to the job site recorded on the agreement is no more than the class's largest distance served.

**2. Charges.** The delivery charge is the class base delivery charge plus the class charge per mile multiplied by the one-way distance, rounded to the nearest cent. The pickup charge is the class pickup percentage of that delivery charge, rounded to the nearest cent. Both are billed at return.

**3. Late truck.** When the delivery truck misses the booked delivery window, rental time starts at the actual delivery time, which is recorded as the checkout time.

## Hypothetical charges

| Class | One-way distance | Delivery charge | Pickup charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 12.5 miles | 149.00 plus 12.5 at 4.00, that is 199.00 | 100 percent, 199.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 25 miles | 79.00 plus 25 at 2.50, that is 141.50 | 100 percent, 141.50 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 26 miles | not offered (beyond 25 miles) | none |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | any | not offered in the class | none |

## Late truck (hypothetical)

A compact track loader is booked for delivery between 07:00 and 09:00 and arrives at 11:40. The checkout time is recorded as 11:40 and rental time runs from then.
